title: Remove repository-wide publication freezes and reduce release reconciliation overhead
body:
## Owner

Programme/root owns intake, selection, complete acceptance and integration under #4730. Retain existing release, publisher, journal and runtime owners. Existing Creator source owner knowledge_supplier carries the root-selected two-file source slice after dispatch. Source selection changes no current publication, reservation, PR or effect.

## Done when

- The maintained publication route accepts an approved immutable candidate revision, artifact digest, dependency closure and release intent while unrelated protected-main merges proceed. Candidate retention and each publication authorization use the revised contract. Preserve fresh current authorization/revocation, trusted workflow/run identity, coherent provenance and protection checks; simply deleting the live-main equality guard is not acceptance.
- Reserve only genuinely conflicting package/version, tag, journal and release-channel resources. Define promotion ordering and any short shared critical section. Demonstrate that competing or obsolete promotions remain fenced while independent repository work proceeds.
- Advance immediately after confirmed reconciliation progress. Use bounded observation/backoff only for genuine remote visibility waits, retaining original operation deadlines, ordered effects, independent readback, journal conflict checks and no blind retry of uncertain writes.
- Reuse verified immutable artifact bytes and pure validation by exact digest where sound. Keep mutable authority, journal and provider state fresh at their required boundaries. Profile repeated prefix verification before changing it; preserve all required evidence rather than claiming cache reuse itself grants authority.
- Expose bounded current-stage/effect timing, last confirmed progress and the exact wait/failure cause through maintained diagnostics. Reuse the existing observer and executor; do not create another scheduler, ledger, reporting worker or per-checkpoint wrapper family.
- Deliver reviewed source and required CI, then qualify a separately admitted ordinary publication and applicable consumer adoption. Controls demonstrate that an unrelated documentation merge permits continued publication of the same approved candidate, changed/revoked authority and a conflicting promotion refuse, and an uncertain push is observed without duplicate publication. Preserve original attempts and failures. Source-only tests or a green workflow alone do not establish full adoption.
- Compare merge-blocked time, publication critical-path duration, API calls and coordinator/agent preparation effort against a proportionate baseline with coverage limits. Separate functional acceptance from numerical savings; inconclusive economics is an explicit result. Coordinate shared orchestration/telemetry improvements with #4743 and #4639/#4640 instead of duplicating their promises.

## Current deliverable

Programme/root accepts the three protected source milestones: verified-progress advancement (PR4757), conservative report-addition source compatibility (PR4761), and diagnostic/readback exclusion from the unchanged writer mutex (PR4764, merge c0ad3a3012013c41a4a64cf645907f9a7f797483). Their reviewed source, required CI, original failures and observability limits remain accepted at their recorded scopes. Full seven-clause acceptance remains incomplete.

The remaining resource-contract investigation is retired. Root selects the actual existing versioned release-visibility semantics: promotion changes only the selected release with draft=false and make_latest=false; there is no shared latest channel or monotonic pointer to invent. Journal CAS prevents conflicting journal updates but does not fence cross-run package or release writes. Same package/version, tag, selected journal or release-resource conflicts must remain excluded irrespective of candidate/run identity. Keep the current writer exclusion until root selects a maintained aggregate Authority/API/hosted-resource profile and enforcement for disjoint writers. No new writer parallelism, short promotion section, framework or effect authority is accepted.

No genuinely needed next ordinary Wizard release intent, immutable candidate and applicable consumer has been supplied or selected. Completed021 and frozen013 history are not eligible competing-run fixtures and must not be replayed. SDD1113 is unrelated to these prerequisites. Remaining publication/adoption, resource-contract, reuse/profile and economic evidence is not waived.

## Next action

Corrected 2026-10-30 by Root/fdev. The previous text listed two reopening events that contradict the [24 Oct Root decision 6385677196](https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4753#issuecomment-6385677196). That decision chose one org-wide serialized writer instead of an aggregate profile, and it dropped the genuine-next-Wizard prerequisite. The serialized lock is delivered as ADR-0097, c799a9f9; Rendering, Game and Coordination publishers use it. Proposal PR #4928 is withdrawn as superseded.

The remaining step is the first ordinary publication of any component through the lock, which serves as the qualifying consumer journey, together with its timing, API and preparation evidence. The selected candidate is Rendering 0.32.4, the accessibility palette in #4817, once its NuGet pre-push gate is resolved or replaced. Root has selected a fingerprint diagnostic and then an advisory-verify/canary-push route. Fresh revocation/protection, original finite clocks, independent readback and no duplicate uncertain writes still apply.

## Blocked on

#4817's NuGet `verifykey` HTTP 400 holds the selected first publication through the lock. Root owns the diagnostic and bypass work, and no external party is required. Full Done when, Acceptance evidence, original attempts and all known/Unknown reservations remain unchanged. Economics may remain inconclusive.
